an4.260:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgan t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.260:1.3: Idha bhikkhave rañño bhadro assājānīyo vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti, balavasampanno ca, javasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an4.260:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro . . . saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.260:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an4.260:2.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti . . . ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an4.260:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti?
an4.260:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti . . . pe . . . samādaya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an4.260:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti.
an4.260:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu balasampanno hoti?
an4.260:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati [akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya] thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an4.260:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu balasampanno hoti.
an4.260:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu javasampanno hoti?
an4.260:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an4.260:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu javasampanno hoti.
an4.260:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu ārohapariṇāhasampanno hoti?
an4.260:6.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ārohapariṇāhasampanno hoti.
an4.260:7.1: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti. 258.
